name: TCFD — Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures
description: Framework for climate-related financial risk disclosure, now mandated in UK (FCA), EU (CSRD), and voluntary globally

governance.name: Governance
governance.description: Board oversight and management's role in assessing climate risks
keyQuestions: Does the board oversee climate-related risks?
Is there a dedicated ESG committee or officer?

strategy.name: Strategy
strategy.description: Actual and potential impacts of climate risks on business, strategy, and financial planning
keyQuestions: Has a scenario analysis been conducted (1.5°C, 2°C, 4°C)?
Are climate risks integrated into financial planning?

riskManagement.name: Risk Management
riskManagement.description: Processes for identifying, assessing, and managing climate-related risks
keyQuestions: Are physical climate risks assessed (flood, heat, storm)?
Is there a business continuity plan covering climate events?

metrics.name: Metrics & Targets
metrics.description: Metrics and targets used to assess and manage climate-related risks
keyQuestions: Is there a science-based target (SBTi) or net-zero commitment?

mandatoryRegions.EU: Mandatory via CSRD/ESRS E1 for large companies

scoringImpact.description: TCFD alignment increases investor confidence and DFI eligibility
